1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than __200 nm__.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a zirconium compound.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine of less than __2000 Da__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, wherein the total concentration of said cations is less than __100 mM__.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than __200 nm__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entraping a multivalent cation __selected from the group consisting of Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe, or Al__.

20) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a delayed gelling agent comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine of less than __2000 Da__ and a polyvinyl sulfonate intimately associated with a multivalent metal cation crosslinker, said nanoparticle having a size of less than __200 nm__; b) a polymer having anionic sites that can be crosslinked with said metal cation crosslinker; and c) a fluid.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid, where said fluid is __brine or seawater__. 

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymer of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or NN, dimethylacrylamide.

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said fluid is __an aqueous solution__.
